# .github

CI workflows for continuous improvement and validation.

## Purpose

- `cip-daily.yml`, `crx-validate.yml` run model/catalog checks.

## Ownership

- Maintained by local-router CI team.

## Local Contracts

- Workflows must not leak secrets; use PQC secrets binding.

## Work Guidance

- Run `npm run lint`/`npm test` in workflows.

## Verification

- Verify CI green after workflow edits.

## Child DOX Index

No child DOX files are required.
